question: When was the first non-synchronous census conducted in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1872.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The first non-synchronous census in India was conducted in 1872.**
 
• This census was conducted under the **British Raj **and covered only **British India**, excluding princely states.
